Pad digits F consist of (14-L) digits of 1111 (F16) after the entered PIN.
For PAN field, the check digit before the field separator is dropped and the remaining right-most 12 digits of Track 2 data are used.
Device may receive 4R or 4< Decline Code if encrypted PIN data is missing or not sent.
Decline may occur if Terminal Profile PIN Encryption type is not set to UKP.
BUYPASS assigns one merchant number and one device number to the overall AFP system.
For American Express, default track should be Track 1; if unreadable, send unaltered Track 2 on initial transaction before manual entry.

Approval Number is required on reversals for matching information to the original purchase.
If Approval Number is included in a Purchase Request, it is considered preauthorized and BUYPASS does not seek authorization.
In an Authorization Only Reversal, Approval Number present in original transaction must be present and identical in the reversal.

aiBusinessRequirements.title: Enhanced Fleet Data must be alphanumeric and must not exceed 999 bytes.
EMV data is not required on Reversal transactions.
If card is not chip or device not chip capable, and card is swiped, send MSR Entry Mode of '90' or spec equivalent.
R indicates required, O indicates optional, C indicates conditional entry for a data element.
Information Byte fixed value is '?' identifying a Download Request.
Software Dial Load Data Segment is sent only on a Software Load Response.
Key Data section repeats up to 3 times (max 48 bytes total); presence based on Key Indicators field.
EMV Request Data Segment is required for all EMV card transactions and is the only segment required for all EMV financial transactions.
Incomm Market Basket Data (Response) Segment returned when Request segment was included in the request.
Standard Message Data Segment is the only required data segment on all Financial Transaction Request messages.
All fields separated by Field Separator; when a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator.
Segment Length includes Segment Type's length and Field Separators.
For DUKPT PIN encryption, Encrypted PIN Block Data is a 16- to 20-byte KSN plus a 16-byte PIN block.
Each Fleet Tag has a 3-byte fixed-length tag portion and up to 31 bytes of data.
a field is not populated — still send the Product Data Field Delimiter.
When a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator or Field Delimiter.
A Field Separator follows Product Amount if it is the last element in the segment.
All fields are separated by Field Separators; unpopulated fields still send Field Separator.
a field is not populated — still send the Field Separator.
Expiration Date is reserved for future use.
Print Data Segment always appears at the end of a Financial Transaction response.
Prompt Code, Pending valid values are 0901, 0902, 0904, 0981.
Device Card Table Version consists of seven version values, each 5 characters, strung together.
Product Code 991 indicates an administrative amount, used in a pre-pay environment when price is adjusted to include discount amount.
Fields are not separated by Field Separators; unpopulated fields are immediately followed by the next field.
Segment 119 always appears in Field No. 3 in Data Section No. 3.
Prompt Code fixed value is 990 identifying format type for requested totals.
Field Nos. 17-19 are sent up to a maximum of 20 times, once for each card type, in order shown.
Print Data 2 Segment is only sent on Financial Transaction Response messages requiring large amounts of print data.
A Field Separator always follows Segment Type and Segment Length, and the last Tax Amount per product.
Prompt Tokens differ by authorizer; different authorizers support different prompts.
Prompt Code 999 indicates no prompts issued.
Table Length for Payee Name has a maximum variable value of 017.
Flags in Table Data must be separated by a comma; if a flag is absent, it can be skipped using just the separator.
Product Data repeated for as many products as needed, separated by '|' and ending with '|'.
Field is included in response only when merchant sent Account Updater Request Indicator with value 'Y' or 'I' in request.
Effective May 1, 2025, expiration date is optional for Accel/STAR COF transactions (bill payment, recurring, installment).
PIN data must be customer-keyed and encrypted using DUKPT; if absent from request, insert a Field Separator.
For EMV offline PIN validated debit, PIN block must contain a PIN or all F's, else transaction declines as invalid transaction.
Secondary Phone Number is used once attempts using the primary Phone Number are exhausted.
A tertiary Phone Number is assigned to but not used by the device.
In Proprietary Load Response (Prompt Code 904), first Product Code instance identifies discount-eligible product, second identifies discount product code for Segment 102.
Quantity valid codes/values are 00000000, 01-399999999.

aiBusinessRequirements.title: Moneris Data (Request) Segment required only for transactions destined for the Moneris authorizer.
All EMV Financial Transaction Requests contain one or more of the listed data segments in Field Nos. 4-8.
For EMV, the first two characters (Device Type) of Terminal Identifier must be '+*' regardless of actual device type.
RQST/CURRENT HASH MATCH code indicates key update is not required.
Segment Type field has fixed value 100 for Standard Message Data Segment.
Value 'Y' in Alternate MICR IND indicates Alternate MICR format is being sent from the terminal.
Fuel Volume Data field length is determined by segment length in field 2, up to max 3,600.
Segment Type fixed value is 119.
Account Updater Expiration Date is applicable only to Visa and MasterCard.
Connector type field has maximum length of 3 characters.
For fuel and nonfuel amounts together with discounts/coupons, discounts/coupons are first applied to the nonfuel amount.
Nonfuel Amount valid values are 1-99999999.
Number of Card Types valid values are 01-99.
Number of Print Lines does not include Data Element 168, Count of Receipt Text Line.
Data Element 168 count does not reflect total from Number of Print Lines.
Number of Print Lines information comes from BUYPASS.
Number of Print Lines valid values are 1, 2, or 3.
Number of Products must precede single digits (1-9) with a zero (01-09).
Number of Products valid values range from 01 to 10.
Financial Transaction Requests: Number of Segments followed by Data Segment 100, plus optional input segments from Chapter 12.
Loyalty Card Transaction Requests: Number of Segments followed by Segment 100, Segment 108, and Segment 114.
ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Requests: Number of Segments followed by Segment 100, Segment 110, and Segment 111.
Totals Requests: Number of Segments always followed by Segment 105, Totals Data Segment.
Electronic Mail Requests: Number of Segments always followed by Segment 109, Electronic Mail Data Segment.
Communications Test Requests: Number of Segments always followed by Element 120, Network Management Message.
TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization: Used for Key and Key ID Load, followed by Segment 116, TransArmor Load Data Segment.
Number of Segments value N indicates transaction has Segment 100 plus N-1 input segments listed in Chapter 12.
Odometer element found in Fleet Data Segment if required by issuer.
Odometer valid values range from 1 to 99999999.
Password required for totals request or electronic mail request.
If password entry is less than six characters, right-align entry using spaces.
Default password is 123456.
PC Duty Amount is used for Purchase Card Transaction Request.
PC Freight Amount is used in Direct Marketing/Address Verification System Request.
PC Tax Amount differs from Element No. 99, Tax Amount.
Transaction dialing always begins with the primary Phone Number.
Safekey Data positions 1-2 must be fixed value 'SK' indicating SafeKey cryptogram transaction.
Safekey Data appears in Data Segment No. 123 (NFC Payment Tokenization Data Segment).

aiBusinessRequirements.title: STAR Signature Debit transactions must occur within US and US territories.
POS Devices processing chip-initiated credit/signature debit transactions must support submitting a PIN in authorization request.
Key Data section repeats up to 3 times (max 48 bytes total); presence based on Key Indicators field.
EMV Request Data Segment is required for all EMV card transactions and is the only segment required for all EMV financial transactions.
Incomm Market Basket Data (Response) Segment returned when Request segment was included in the request.
Standard Message Data Segment is the only required data segment on all Financial Transaction Request messages.
Segment Length includes Segment Type's length and Field Separators.
For DUKPT PIN encryption, Encrypted PIN Block Data is a 16- to 20-byte KSN plus a 16-byte PIN block.
Each Fleet Tag has a 3-byte fixed-length tag portion and up to 31 bytes of data.
a field is not populated — still send the Product Data Field Delimiter.
When a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator or Field Delimiter.
A Field Separator follows Product Amount if it is the last element in the segment.
All fields are separated by Field Separators; unpopulated fields still send Field Separator.
a field is not populated — still send the Field Separator.
Expiration Date is reserved for future use.
Print Data Segment always appears at the end of a Financial Transaction response.
Prompt Code, Pending valid values are 0901, 0902, 0904, 0981.
Device Card Table Version consists of seven version values, each 5 characters, strung together.
Product Code 991 indicates an administrative amount, used in a pre-pay environment when price is adjusted to include discount amount.
Fields are not separated by Field Separators; unpopulated fields are immediately followed by the next field.
Segment 119 always appears in Field No. 3 in Data Section No. 3.
Prompt Code fixed value is 990 identifying format type for requested totals.
Field Nos. 17-19 are sent up to a maximum of 20 times, once for each card type, in order shown.
Print Data 2 Segment is only sent on Financial Transaction Response messages requiring large amounts of print data.
A Field Separator always follows Segment Type and Segment Length, and the last Tax Amount per product.
Prompt Tokens differ by authorizer; different authorizers support different prompts.
Prompt Code 999 indicates no prompts issued.
Table Length for Payee Name has a maximum variable value of 017.
Flags in Table Data must be separated by a comma; if a flag is absent, it can be skipped using just the separator.
Product Data repeated for as many products as needed, separated by '|' and ending with '|'.
Prompt Data repeated for as many prompts as needed, separated by '|' and ending with '|'.
Field is included in response only when merchant sent Account Updater Request Indicator with value 'Y' or 'I' in request.
Secondary Phone Number is used once attempts using the primary Phone Number are exhausted.
A tertiary Phone Number is assigned to but not used by the device.
Card Type codes 127-168 turn on specific device features and are not used in any Prompt Codes.
Decline codes prompt clerk/customer to reenter only the specific data indicated in the prompt.
Table Data for Partial Approval Indicator valid values: 0=Not supported, 1=Supported, 5=Supports balance receipt but not partial approval.
Table ID for Originating Device Type Indicator is fixed value 022.
Table Data default value is 00 (Card) if not specified.
When Variable Information Indicator = 035 (Verified by Visa Data), merchant must send XID and CAVV in binary data format.
Merchant must send UCAF data with subfield ID value 43 and subfield length 28 within the 32 bytes of UCAF data.
Fraud Enhanced Data Table ID fixed value 039, length fixed at 8 bytes.
Final Amount Indicator allowed only on EMV initial transactions where final Settlement Amount may differ from Authorization Amount.
Final Amount Indicator should NOT be sent when final Settlement Amount equals original Authorization Amount.
Third Party Installment Payment Providers must include their name and underlying retailer name in format 'Third party name*underlying merchant name'.
Table length should be '1' when sending only Program Protocol, or '37' when sending both Program Protocol and Directory Server Transaction ID.
Sub-Table ID fixed value is 02 for entity initiating transaction sub-table.
This field must be spaces if not used by merchant.
Security Condition values 8-9 are reserved for private use.

aiBusinessRequirements.title: Enhanced Fleet Data must be alphanumeric and must not exceed 999 bytes.
Moneris Data (Request) Segment required only for transactions destined for the Moneris authorizer.
All EMV Financial Transaction Requests contain one or more of the listed data segments in Field Nos. 4-8.
For EMV, the first two characters (Device Type) of Terminal Identifier must be '+*' regardless of actual device type.
RQST/CURRENT HASH MATCH code indicates key update is not required.
Fuel Volume Data field length is determined by segment length in field 2, up to max 3,600.
Segment Type fixed value is 119.
Account Updater Expiration Date is applicable only to Visa and MasterCard.
Connector type field has maximum length of 3 characters.
For fuel and nonfuel amounts together with discounts/coupons, discounts/coupons are first applied to the nonfuel amount.
Nonfuel Amount valid values are 1-99999999.
Number of Card Types valid values are 01-99.
Number of Print Lines does not include Data Element 168, Count of Receipt Text Line.
Data Element 168 count does not reflect total from Number of Print Lines.
Number of Print Lines information comes from BUYPASS.
Number of Print Lines valid values are 1, 2, or 3.
Number of Products must precede single digits (1-9) with a zero (01-09).
Number of Products valid values range from 01 to 10.
Financial Transaction Requests: Number of Segments followed by Data Segment 100, plus optional input segments from Chapter 12.
Loyalty Card Transaction Requests: Number of Segments followed by Segment 100, Segment 108, and Segment 114.
ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Requests: Number of Segments followed by Segment 100, Segment 110, and Segment 111.
Totals Requests: Number of Segments always followed by Segment 105, Totals Data Segment.
Electronic Mail Requests: Number of Segments always followed by Segment 109, Electronic Mail Data Segment.
Communications Test Requests: Number of Segments always followed by Element 120, Network Management Message.
TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization: Used for Key and Key ID Load, followed by Segment 116, TransArmor Load Data Segment.
Number of Segments value N indicates transaction has Segment 100 plus N-1 input segments listed in Chapter 12.
Odometer element found in Fleet Data Segment if required by issuer.
Odometer valid values range from 1 to 99999999.
Password required for totals request or electronic mail request.
If password entry is less than six characters, right-align entry using spaces.
Default password is 123456.
PC Duty Amount is used for Purchase Card Transaction Request.
PC Freight Amount is used in Direct Marketing/Address Verification System Request.
PC Tax Amount differs from Element No. 99, Tax Amount.
Transaction dialing always begins with the primary Phone Number.
Safekey Data positions 1-2 must be fixed value 'SK' indicating SafeKey cryptogram transaction.
Safekey Data appears in Data Segment No. 123 (NFC Payment Tokenization Data Segment).
For Visa Card Type, cardholder name data is variable length up to 105 digits including Middle Name after First and Last Name.
NVS Table ID is fixed value 034 with length 3 bytes.
Value 4 (Identity Check Insights) means no fraud liability shift since issuer does not receive authentication request.
MCX Checkout Token Table ID fixed value 037, length fixed value 040, data an40.
Paydiant Tender ID Table ID fixed value 038, length fixed value 012, data an12.
